posts.description: Welcome! I’m a pessimistic nerd who is deep in the weeds of infrastructure, security, and dev tooling. I work at Pierre Computer Company . Outside work, I am an open source enthusiast who builds things for the poor. I am also running a newsletter Identity, Authenticity, and Security , if you like my work, please consider giving it a look! I’ve programmed with VB 6.0, VB.NET, C# from 2011 to 2013.

posts.title: Managing stack pull requests with git-spice
posts.description: This blog post is a counterpart of my earlier post Managing stack pull requests with Graphite . Because I have quit my previous company that purchases Graphite licenses, and also because Graphite is priced ridiculously high (that I can’t afford out-of-pocket), and I don’t use its UI, for reasons, I am still more comfortable using GitHub UI, maybe because that’s more familiar to me. $20 per user/mo
